text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, who will make the move?! Who will be 
the one to bring this heated battle to an 
end?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. It's giving me chills...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, your true best makes my heart 
flutter this much!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: No, that's not it. This is—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Is this... your way of running?!
(WOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAHH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ngh...... so strong......!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...I see. This is the strength of your 
rival, Chiyo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry. If I run with you, I'll lose 
my future..."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Chiyo-chan. Would you mind 
answering a question for me?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Do you still want to run with me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I want to run!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I refuse to let it end on a 
loss! Next time, I'm definitely going to 
win!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I am Sakura Chiyono O, Maruzen-san's 
rival!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Sakura Chiyono O here is my wonderful 
rival.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll always welcome a rematch. As long as 
you keep running, the possibility of 
surpassing me will never fade.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let you beat me easily, though! 
Let's race again sometime, Chiyo-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. Chiyo-chan! And another one, 
please!!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I had so... much fun! That was the 
greatest race of my life!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Did you have fun, Chiyo-chan?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...! Of course I had fun!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Th-Thanks! I'll be counting on you.

This is not the end of the race for the 
two of them.

As long as they exist, as long as they 
have rivals, as long as those two keep 
running, the race will go on—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, uuu... uuuuugh~...! ...Next time, 
I'll... absolutely...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I'll get stronger... even stronger...! I 
absolutely won't lose...!!"

You can shed plenty of tears in between. 
Those won't be tears of regret, but tears 
of frustration.

"Once she sheds all those tears, she will 
surely begin walking toward the future 
again."
